official_definition: When your Spirits would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can draw a card. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can send an opposing Life to the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Grudging Curse] or [Grudging Curse: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Grudging Curse]", "give [Grudging Curse]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
